derivations.quote:
Suppose a row field ahead of both chunks has length divisible by $W^k$. Within each prefix, rows are split into role streams by [stream scans](stream-ops.md): row $Wx+w-1$ goes to stream $w$ as row $x$. Each stream has volume $V/W$ and row count divisible by $W^{k-1}$. Read wire $w$'s input $f_w$ as the logical array $\Phi_{-M_{\mathrm{in}(w)}}f_w$. By the composition rule and the contract, the output is $f'_{\rho(w)}=\Phi_{M_{\mathrm{out}(\rho(w))}}\Phi_{-M_{\mathrm{in}(w)}}f_w=\Phi_{I_m}f_w$. Merging rows back undoes $\rho$, giving $H\gets H+D$ on every original row.

Each call acts on volume $V/W$; other work is $O(V)$. The time per unit volume $F_k$ at width $m^k$ obeys $F_0=O(1)$, $F_k\le(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1)$, the recurrence of [Recursive power saving](rank-recurrence.md). Unrolled over levels $j$, $F_k=O(\sum_{j=0}^k (s/W)^j)$. If $s/W\le1$ this is at most $k+1=O(m^{k\tau})$; otherwise it is $O((s/W)^k)$, below $m^{k\tau}$. So $F_k=O(e^\tau)$.

For large $e$, put $k'=\lceil\log_m eceil$ and $
u=\lceil k'\log W/(2\log q)ceil$, so $q^{2
u}\ge W^{k'}$, $1\le
u<e$ and $
u=O(\log 2e)$; small $e$ use single-digit interchanges. Split each chunk into top $
u$ digits and rest, $h^+,h^-$ and $d^+,d^-$. Interchange the high digits and move $h^+$ next to $d^+$: $(h^+,h^-,g,d^+,d^-)$ becomes $(d^+,h^+,h^-,g,d^-)$. Now $d^+,h^+$ form a row field of range $\Lambda=q^{2
u}\ge W^{k'}$ before both remaining chunks. Pad with zero rows to $\Lambda'=W^{k'}\lceil \Lambda/W^{k'}ceil<2\Lambda$ rows (volume below $2V$). Write $e-
u=\sum_{j=0}^{k'}a_jm^j$, $0\le a_j<m$. Split each remaining chunk into $a_j$ pieces of width $m^j$ and interchange corresponding pieces as above. The total $O(V)\sum_ja_jm^{j	au}\le O(V)\,m\sum_jm^{j	au}=O(Ve^	au)$, since $m^{k'}<me$. Scan away padded rows and reverse the joining, giving $(d^+,d^-,g,h^+,h^-)$ at cost $O(V
u)=O(Ve^	au)$.
